current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
Each operating limitation specified in Secs. 27.1503 through 27.1525 and other information necessary for safe operation, must be--
(a) Included in the Rotorcraft Flight Manual;
(b) Expressed in markings and placards; and
(c) Made available by any other means that will convey the information to the crewmembers.

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
[Each operating limitation specified in Secs. 27.1503 through 27.1525 and other information necessary for safe operation, must--
(a) For each rotorcraft, other than a helicopter, be included in the Rotorcraft Flight Manual and expressed in placards and markings;
(b) For each helicopter, be included in a Rotorcraft Flight Manual or in approved manual material, unless the operating rules of this chapter require a Rotorcraft Flight Manual, and expressed in placards and markings; and
(c) Be made available by any other means that will convey the information to the crewmembers.]

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
[(a) Each operating limitation specified in Secs. 27.1503 through 27.1525 and other limitations and information necessary for safe operation, must be established.
(b) The operating limitations and other information necessary for safe operation must be made available to the crewmembers as prescribed in Secs. 27.1541 through 27.1589.]
